name: ssl-bc2-drum-glue
description: Gentle SSL-style bus glue on a stereo drum bus via SSL Native Bus Compressor 2: 4:1, slow 30 ms attack so the kick/snare crack through, AUTO release for transparent program-dependent recovery, ~3-4 dB GR, makeup to match. VALIDATED on the Watercolors warm drum bus (crest 17.17->16.49, LRA 2.44->2.07 tighter, +0.73 LU, true-peak still -0.98). Glue = modest GR + slow attack + AUTO release, NOT heavy squash.
intended_for: a stereo drum bus / submix that needs cohesion + a touch of density without losing punch
plugin_build: SSL Native Bus Compressor 2.vst3 (SSL Native, iLok/PACE machine-activated; renders headless via Pedalboard, changed:true on this rig — iLok render-farm landmine, re-verify on a new machine)
notes: THRESHOLD is relative to INPUT LEVEL, not dBFS — +5 gave ~3-4 dB GR on a -17 LUFS / -1 dBFS bus. On other material re-dial threshold to land ~2-4 dB GR (lower threshold = more GR) and reset makeup to match. Don't trust the number; watch the GR.
Slow 30 ms attack measured = transients PASS (peak -9.0 vs -11.4 at 0.1 ms): the kick/snare punch through. Fast attack (0.1-3 ms) clamps them. The textbook holds here (unlike the API Vision strip).
AUTO release = transparent program-dependent glue (crest ~18); fixed fast releases (0.1-0.6 s) pump harder (crest ~21) — use those for aggression/pump, not clean glue.
For more punch retention, blend dry_wet_mix down toward 60-80% (parallel).
Verify: crest down a touch (not collapsed), LRA tighter, true-peak safe, GR ~2-4 dB. Louder != better — judge by crest.
